description: Run a shell command in a sandbox and return its exit code, stdout and stderr when it ends. It runs under bash -c as the user prized (no sudo), in /home/prized/work unless cwd says otherwise. A non-zero exit code is a result, not a tool error. Each stream is cut to its first 5,000 and last 15,000 characters; redirect long output to a file and read parts of it. It is killed after timeout_seconds (default 240, at most 3,600); progress is reported while it runs. For a server or a longer job, start it in the background (nohup cmd > log.txt 2>&1 &) and check on it with later commands; a sandbox with auto-pause on pauses it after the idle minutes. A paused sandbox is resumed first.

command.description: The shell command, such as "python3 -m venv ~/.venv && ~/.venv/bin/pip install -r requirements.txt && ~/.venv/bin/python app.py".

cwd.description: Working directory. Absolute, or relative to /home/prized/work; ~ is /home/prized. Default /home/prized/work.

env.description: Extra environment variables for this command only, on top of the sandbox's own.

sandbox_id.description: The sandbox id (sbx_...), from create_sandbox or list_sandboxes.

timeout_seconds.description: Kill the command after this many seconds. Default 240, at most 3,600.

name: run_command

durationMs.description: How long it ran, in ms.

exitCode.description: The command's exit code; -1 when it timed out or ended without one.

note.description: Why it was killed or what was left out, and how to get the rest.

stderr.description: Its stderr, cut the same way.

stdout.description: Its stdout: the first 5,000 and last 15,000 characters when longer.

timedOut.description: True when it hit timeout_seconds and was killed.

truncated.description: True when part of stdout or stderr was left out.

title: Run a command in a sandbox
